form.label: Status Overview
form.description: Latest result of every website check in the time range. Click a row for its history.

search.query: sourcetype="web_ping" `website_monitoring_search_index` | `set_response_code` | `set_status` | stats sparkline(avg(total_time)) as sparkline_response_time latest(title) as title latest(url) as url latest(status) as status latest(response_code) as response latest(total_time) as response_time avg(total_time) as average max(total_time) as maximum count as checks range(_time) as span latest(_time) as last_checked by source | eval usual_gap=if(checks > 1, span / (checks - 1), null()) | eval stale=case(isnull(usual_gap), "unknown", now() - last_checked > 2 * usual_gap, "yes", true(), "no") | eval response_time=round(response_time, 0), average=round(average, 0), maximum=round(maximum, 0) | `timesince(last_checked,last_checked)`

| search status="$show$" | eval rank=case(status=="Failed", 0, status=="Warning", 1, true(), 2) | sort 0 rank title | table title url status response response_time average maximum sparkline_response_time last_checked stale

html.p: A check is Failed when its response code matches the macro response_codes_to_alert_on (default: 400 and above), when no response arrived, when the page lacks the expected text, or when the response took at least response_time_threshold ms (default 1000). It is a Warning from response_time_threshold_warning ms (default 800). An input with its own error_threshold and warning_threshold uses those instead of the two time macros.
Change what counts as a failure in Settings › Advanced search › Search macros.
stale is yes when the latest check of an input is older than twice its usual interval: the input was disabled or removed, or its checks stopped running.
